answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a non-refundable bond at dawn of its existence, then continuously produce unique non-transferable contribution proofs via sequential stateful interaction with a shared mesa of economic tasks. The resulting nectar of verified history cannot be cloned: an attacker must fund a separate bond and rebuild an independent contribution chain for every fake identity, multiplying capital lockup and opportunity cost linearly with the number of sybils and making mass farming unprofitable.
